_comment: Single source of truth for councilof.ai's ruled public invariants. The drift-guard asserts the LIVE site matches these. When a ruling changes a value (e.g. public_count moves), change it HERE in one place and the guard follows. Do not hand-edit the live site to a value that contradicts this file. Cite live GET /api/gspc for scores.
ruling: LIVE · 2026-08-26 · GSPC board swept under ADR-001: 22 axes · 15 measured (14 GSPC behavioural + 8 financial/domain; 7 financial slots are DECLARED and UNMEASURED)

api._comment: These are the guard's EXPECTED values, not a surface. A guard has to name the number it is checking for — that is what makes drift detectable — so this is the one place in the estate where an axis count is written down, and every rendered surface derives from the endpoint instead. Read off the signed board, not typed from memory: see _provenance.
api._provenance: public/signed/gspc-board.signed.json -> totals, read 2026-08-26 after the ADR-001 sweep wired the 8 financial/domain axes into the signed payload and re-signed it. Previously 14/14/14 with public_count_contains '14 measured of 14 quotable' — that was the un-swept state, correct at the time and superseded by the data, not by copy.
api._grammar: axes_total counts SLOTS; measured_axes counts slots with a real run behind them; unmeasured_axes is published so the gap is visible. The two must always travel together in public copy — quoting axes_total alone would claim 7 measurements that do not exist.
